_note: Shared golden fixture. Read by BOTH Tools/MemoryBench (against its transcribed MirroredTokeniser/MirroredChunker) and StrandTests (against the app's own CoachMemory.tokens and CoachSemanticMemory.chunkTexts). The benchmark cannot import the app target, so it carries a copy of that logic; unit tests on either side alone would let both stay internally consistent while drifting apart. This file is what makes that impossible.
